id: 21_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Setting Regulator Pre
title: 开瓶阀与调压力
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/21_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Setting Regulator Pre.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/21_Fundamentals of Handling Compressed Gas Cylinders Safely – Setting Regulator Pre/src.py

points.K9: 出口阀管流量，调压阀管压力

shots.scene: 欣欣站在装好减压器的气瓶旁，双表朝向镜头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gas cylinder standing upright, fitted with a two-gauge pressure regulator, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲开瓶阀和调节输出压力。

shots.scene: 两只压力表图标，一只标进口、一只标出口
shots.prompt_en: Two round pressure gauge icons side by side with blank dials, connected by a short pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 一只表看瓶里，一只表看输出。

shots.scene: 阿杰正对着减压器出口，伸手猛拧瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands directly in front of the regulator outlet and grabs the cylinder valve handwheel, about to twist it hard.
shots.narration: 阿杰站在表的正前方，想一把拧开瓶阀。

shots.scene: 正对出口站立、猛拧阀门的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing in front of a regulator outlet and twisting a valve fast, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 出口对着自己，这样很不安全。

shots.scene: 小研把阿杰拉到气瓶侧面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently moves the young male student to the side of the cylinder.
shots.narration: 小研让他换个位置，慢慢来。

shots.scene: 小研站在气瓶侧面，减压器出口指向另一边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves, stands at the side of the cylinder; the regulator outlet points away from her.
shots.narration: 开阀时侧身站，出口不对着自己。

shots.scene: 手掌盖在阀门顶上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a palm placed flat over the top of a cylinder valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手也别放在阀门正上方。

shots.scene: 小研用手握住瓶阀手轮慢慢转动
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly turns the cylinder valve handwheel by hand.
shots.narration: 用手慢慢打开瓶阀。

shots.scene: 一把专用阀门扳手配供应商图标
shots.prompt_en: A special cylinder valve key next to a delivery truck icon representing the gas supplier. No people.
shots.narration: 供应商规定用专用工具时，才用工具。

shots.scene: 进口压力表指针上升，旁边一个虚线目标框
shots.prompt_en: The inlet pressure gauge needle rises and stops inside a dotted target zone on a blank dial. No people.
shots.narration: 看进口压力表，读数应在预期之内。

shots.scene: 指针停在很低的位置，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: The inlet gauge needle stops far below the dotted target zone, with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 压力比预期低？先别急着用。

shots.scene: 快空的气瓶图标和冒气的瓶阀图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a nearly empty cylinder and a cylinder valve with a small gas puff escaping. No people.
shots.narration: 可能快用空了，也可能瓶阀漏气。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，老周皱眉点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man next to the cylinder; he frowns and nods.
shots.narration: 瓶阀漏气是严重问题，要找实验室主管。

shots.scene: 小研缓慢顺时针转动调压手轮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly turns the large regulator adjusting knob clockwise while watching the gauge.
shots.narration: 慢慢转调压手轮，边转边看表。

shots.scene: 输出表指针停在空白规程卡上标的位置
shots.prompt_en: The delivery gauge needle settles on a mark that matches a blank procedure card beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 调到仪器和规程要求的压力。

shots.scene: 表盘满刻度处亮红光，旁边红叉
shots.prompt_en: A gauge dial with its maximum scale end glowing red and a red X beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 表的满刻度，不是安全工作压力。

shots.scene: 小研慢慢打开减压器出口小阀，气流箭头流向仪器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly opens the small outlet valve; a gentle arrow shows gas flowing to an instrument.
shots.narration: 再慢慢打开出口阀，向系统供气。

shots.section_title: 出口阀管流量，调压阀管压力
shots.scene: 出口阀旁是流量箭头，调压手轮旁是压力表
shots.prompt_en: Split icon: the outlet valve paired with a flow arrow, the adjusting knob paired with a pressure gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 出口阀只管流量，不管压力。
overlay: 出口阀管流量，调压阀管压力

shots.section_title: 出口阀管流量，调压阀管压力
shots.scene: 用出口阀调压力的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand turning the outlet valve while staring at the pressure gauge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 要改压力，只能用调压手轮。

shots.scene: 通气后输出表指针稍稍下滑
shots.prompt_en: After gas starts flowing, the delivery gauge needle drops slightly below the mark. No people.
shots.narration: 通气后，输出压力会略有下降。

shots.scene: 小研看表，轻轻微调手轮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches the delivery gauge and makes a small adjustment to the knob.
shots.narration: 复核一下，需要时再微调。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现侧身站和慢转手轮图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a person standing sideways and a slowly turning handwheel.
shots.narration: 出口朝外，手不压阀，慢慢开。

shots.scene: 进口表、调压手轮、出口阀三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an inlet gauge with a question mark, an adjusting knob and an outlet valve with a flow arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 压力低要报告，调压阀管压力。

shots.scene: 出口阀慢开、输出表复核两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: an outlet valve opening slowly and a delivery gauge being rechecked. No people.
shots.narration: 出口阀慢开，通气后复核压力。

shots.scene: 欣欣在调好压力的气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a gas cylinder with its regulator set.
shots.narration: 稳稳开阀，准准调压，下次见！
